# Northside Intelligence (NI) — Agentic LLM & Tool Specification
> High-performance artificial intelligence platform, specialized automation tools, and autonomous commerce endpoints.

## Provider Info
- Name: Northside Intelligence
- URL: https://northsideintelligence.com
- Contact: jb@northsideintelligence.com
- Protocol: WebMCP v1.0

## Available Agentic Offerings & Tool Endpoints

### 1. ReplyFlow (Sector 3 — Automated Lead & DM Follow-up)
- Endpoint: https://northsideintelligence.com/api/webmcp
- Primary Tool: `ni_replyflow_subscribe` ($15/mo standard, $22.50/mo agentic)
- Purpose: Automated lead DM and cold outreach follow-up response generator for small businesses and creators.

### 2. GapScan (Sector 3 — Digital Gap Analysis & Profit Leak Audits)
- Endpoint: https://northsideintelligence.com/api/webmcp
- Primary Tool: `ni_gapscan_run` ($18 single scan, $18/mo standard, $27/mo agentic)
- Purpose: Evidence-backed digital gap reports, website performance audits, and digital funnel leak scans.

### 3. GrantBot (Sector 3 — Grant Search & Application Automation)
- Endpoint: https://northsideintelligence.com/api/webmcp
- Primary Tool: `ni_grantbot_search` ($39/mo standard, $58.50/mo agentic)
- Purpose: Automated grant search, RFP matching, and proposal drafting for non-profits, artists, and creators.

### 4. BridgeAI (Sector 3 — Legacy Software AI Modernization)
- Endpoint: https://northsideintelligence.com/api/webmcp
- Primary Tool: `ni_bridgeai_run` ($29/mo standard, $43.50/mo agentic)
- Purpose: Connect legacy databases and business workflows to modern AI agent endpoints without code rebuilds.

### 5. Signal Desk (Sector 3 — Market Signal & Competitor Intelligence Radar)
- Endpoint: https://northsideintelligence.com/api/webmcp
- Primary Tool: `ni_signaldesk_brief` ($24/mo standard, $36/mo agentic)
- Purpose: Curated daily executive market trend radar and competitor monitoring platform.

### 6. Smart Store (Sector 4 — Curated Gadgets & Dropship Hardware)
- Endpoint: https://northsideintelligence.com/api/webmcp
- Tools: `ni_store_search`, `ni_store_order`
- Purpose: Verified dropship consumer gadgets, smart home tools, and work-from-home accessories.

### 7. NI Core Services (Sector 2 — Bespoke AI Infrastructure & Web Design Agency)
- Endpoint: https://northsideintelligence.com/api/webmcp
- Primary Tool: `ni_services_reserve` ($499 deposit)
- Purpose: Bespoke web design, custom intelligence server setup, and enterprise AI automation workflows.

### 8. Match Fit (Sector 1A — Online Personal Fitness Marketplace)
- URL: https://match-fit.net
- Tools: `mf_search_coaches`, `mf_book_coach`
- Purpose: Nationwide certified online personal fitness trainer finder and coaching directory.
